svg.title: Hi there 👋, Name's Nikos — @karagionikos
svg.desc: Studying Applied Informatics in Computer Science at the University of Macedonia, Thessaloniki Building web tools, desktop apps, systems programs, pipelines, plus machine learning coursework I care about design: clean, minimalistic, retro/skeuomorphic UI, dark themes with accent colors Always up for new software projects Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikolaos-karageorgis · Portfolio: https://karagionikos.github.io/Portfolio/. Repositories: Portfolio, Glyph, Simple-File-System-in-C, Music-Controller-App-for-Spotify, Classification-Problem-Solved-W-Machine-Learning, Neural-Networks-in-Computer-Vision, Unity-3rd-Person-Movement-Camera.
